title: Synthesis of reactive P-N intumescence flame retardant and its application in cotton fabric
authors: WU Denghui; LI Xinhang; ZHAO Peihua

LOI_statistic: Reported measured value; replication and uncertainty unreported
LOI_specimen_preparation: Untreated reference cotton fabric, 300 mm × 58 mm; no durability wash assigned.
source_numeric_evidence_description: Own measured LOI from section 2.4; treated 27.3 repeated in Table 4 zero-wash row. TG maximum-rate temperatures and control residue from Table 3. Figure 7/8 pixels inspected for consistency only.
TG_locator: Table 3 and its footnote, printed page 1140 (PDF page 5); section 2.6, printed pages 1140–1141
LOI_locator: Section 2.4, printed page 1140; Table 4 zero-wash row, page 1141
source_location: Official PDF pages 2–3 and 5–7, printed pages 1137–1138 and 1140–1142: own preparation, TG/LOI methods, Tables 3–4 and conclusion
source_residue_definition: Table 3 explicitly labels residual carbon percentage at 700 °C; treated entry held for the abstract/body conflict
source_initial_degradation_definition: Ton-set: initial decomposition temperature; operational criterion unstated
source_Tmax_definition: Tmax1: first-stage maximum decomposition-rate temperature; Tmax2: second-stage maximum decomposition-rate temperature
limitations: The final PDF and its tables define the prepared states. The official landing-page abstract uses an earlier 20% treatment label and residue 35.7%, whereas the final PDF uses 200 g/L and Table 3 gives 35.6%. The final PDF abstract also associates 48.6% residue with the treated-fabric discussion, while section 2.2 assigns 48.6% to neat TTCTG; treated-fabric residue is therefore held. Native Ton-set is defined only as initial decomposition temperature, without an operational onset criterion or percentage-loss threshold, and is retained outside canonical onset/T5 fields. Table 3 explicitly defines Tmax1 and Tmax2 as first- and second-stage maximum decomposition-rate temperatures. Other concentrations and durability-washed fabrics have no matching TG. Preparation lists 350 g/L and Figure 7 contains its point, but the named product list and Tables 1–2 stop at 300 g/L. No unlabelled plot values are estimated. TG aliquot mass, pan, cutting, conditioning and replication, and LOI replication and uncertainty are unreported. The official seven-page PDF contains all main sections through the conclusion; its references continue on printed page 1160, which is not included in that download. No methods are transferred from the landing page or cited papers.
composition: Commercial cotton fabric, 122 g/m²; weave and supplier unreported
treatment_method: Commercial cotton fabric used as the untreated reference; treatment-specific solvent, catalyst, curing and rinsing are not assigned to this control.
washing_state: Untreated reference; no durability wash assigned
pairing_evidence: Section 2.4 assigns measured LOI 18.1 to pure cotton fabric; Table 3 assigns Tmax1 357 °C and R700 15.9% to that same control, with own methods in section 1.3.

sample_state: TTCTG200-CF; 200 g/L bath; preparative rinse; zero durability washes
composition: Cotton fabric, 122 g/m², finished using 200 g/L TTCTG and 20 g/L sodium hypophosphite in ethanol/water 1:1 by volume; retained add-on unreported
treatment_method: TTCTG was synthesized from cyanuric chloride, triethyl phosphite and glycerol through the PCC intermediate (sections 1.2.1–1.2.2). Cotton fabric was immersed for 2 h at 40 °C in 200 g/L TTCTG plus 20 g/L sodium hypophosphite dissolved in ethanol/water 1:1 by volume, predried at 80 °C for 5 min, cured at 160 °C for 3 min, rinsed with water and air-dried at room temperature. Liquor ratio, pickup, retained add-on and rinse duration are unreported.
washing_state: Preparative water rinse after curing; zero additional durability-washing cycles
pairing_evidence: Table 3 explicitly names TTCTG200-CF. The same section-1.2.3 finished state has LOI 27.3 in section 2.4 and in Table 4 at zero durability washes. Initial TG is not assigned to any later durability-washed state.
